summary.text: Tom Oliverson is a Republican state representative who has represented Texas House District 130 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Oliverson first took office in the Texas House in 2017.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Insurance Committee and a member of the Public Health Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
He defeated Brett Robinson in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with no opponent.
Robinson, a Democrat, is again his opponent in the 2026 general election.
